content.short: Gami Labs runs a professional DeFi vault platform for institutional allocators.
content.description: Gami Labs curates DeFi vaults for institutional allocators, separating flagship strategies from more advanced ones so risk appetite determines the product, not the position size. Custody runs through ForDefi under MPC with a two-of-three admin quorum, and Hypernative provides real-time monitoring across every chain, asset and protocol in use. The platform layers protocol-level threat detection and operational governance on top of that. Strategies include liquidity bootstrapping programs for emerging protocols offering programmable incentives.
content.meta: Gami Labs runs a professional DeFi vault platform for institutional allocators on Robinhood Chain.
